name: Luna Crescent Pendant
description: A delicate crescent moon pendant set in champagne gold-plated alloy, adorned with hand-set cubic zirconia stones. Each curve mirrors the night sky.

name: Aurelia Ring
description: A statement cocktail ring featuring a cushion-cut champagne crystal surrounded by pavé-set clear stones. Adjustable band fits sizes 6–9.

name: Celeste Drop Earrings
description: Graceful drop earrings with cascading oval aquamarine-tinted crystals set in rhodium-plated sterling. Light catches every movement.

name: Soleil Bangle
description: This gold-tone twisted bangle is one-of-a-kind — shaped by hand and finished with a satin brushed texture. No two will ever be alike.

name: Aria Layered Necklace
description: A three-strand layered necklace in gold and pearl tones. Each strand is individually adjustable and can be worn separately or together.

name: Iris Statement Earrings
description: Bold, architectural clip-on earrings shaped like geometric irises. Gold-plated brass with hand-painted enamel accents in ivory and sage.
